RULED by DEC-130 (full structure): (M~, T_BTZ) carries a full singular (Isom(M^3), M^3)-structure, GX.BTZTildeData.singularGXStructure (a maximal a.e. atlas, DEC-25), which IS the pulled-back flat structure p^*B (aeAtlas_space, p an a.e. morphism), with Reg = p^-1(reg M) (reg_space), D an a.e. morphism into M^3 (isAEMorphismOf_dev), and every singular point the centre of a E_0~-chart of def:atlas over the model family {E_0~} (hasXAType_of_mem_sing; IsBTZTildeSingModelled), E_0~ = BTZTildeTB Phi with its own structure (the same construction applied to the model datum btzTildeModel). (M~, T_BTZ) is moreover Hausdorff, locally path-connected, first countable and connected

findings: l.2310: with the BTZ topology T_BTZ (finer than the natural one) it is not automatic that the singular points of M~ stay singular; proved here (GX.BTZTildeData.reg_space): a T_BTZ-chart at a point over sing M would make D, on a lifted chart, a single translate of the chart, so D(U) would be an open neighbourhood of a point of the BTZ line inside g.J+(Delta), which has empty interior there (GX.btzDevM_range_notMem_nhds). The paper does not state this fact; it is what makes 'singular points modelled on E_0~' meaningful.
questions: 'BTZ~-manifold' (l.2310) is formalized, like the hypothesis 'E_0-manifold' (l.2300, IsBTZSingModelled), by the hasType clause of DEC-67 (e): every singular point is the centre of an E_0~-chart (IsBTZTildeSingModelled). The atlas clause of IsXAManifold (every point, regular ones included, in the domain of an E_0~-chart) is neither assumed of M nor proved of M~ (it holds for the model itself, GX.btzTildeModel_isXAManifold). Is the hasType reading, symmetric with the hypothesis, the one DEC-130 intends?

kb_proposals: A type synonym carrying a second topology (WithWrappedTop T) breaks `h.dense` / `h.continuousOn` dot notation when h's type mentions the synonym's carrier: the instance argument is re-synthesized for the carrier (natural topology) and Lean reports 'synthesized instance not defeq'. Use `@IsPortly.dense _ T _ h`, or functions typed on the synonym (BTZTildeData.dev, not .D).
On a type synonym, write the binder type in `∀ᶠ y : d.Space in 𝓝 z, d.D y = ...`: without it `y` is inferred from `d.D`'s domain (the carrier) and `𝓝 z` silently uses the NATURAL topology.

Pullback recipe for a finer topology T' on a covering: show p^-1(reg) is T'-portly and p is a T'-local homeomorphism there (OpenPartialHomeomorph.retopBTZ), then aePullback_spec_of_isAELocalHomeomorph gives the structure; to keep the singular points singular, use rigidity (exists_smul_eq_on_of_isPreconnected) on a lifted chart plus a no-interior fact for the developing image.
